killedBy: hud.css: the stock-loss cue arms (issue #230) splits the six hull swatches into two even rows, not five and a stranded one
why: Widens the narrow-viewport cap from three swatch columns back to six, which is the same as having no cap at all: six columns are 6x44 + 5x12 = 324px, wider than the 320px line the cap exists to divide, so the row falls back to the 5 + 1 split this rule was added to remove. Measured on the real build at 320x568 with the cap defeated -- 324px and wider keep all six swatches on one line, 323px and below strand the sixth on a line of its own.
